acceptanceCriteria: The failure is reproduced or bounded: record host, Go version, parallelism and p95 across at least 10 runs under parallel package load.
The test no longer fails solely due to unrelated parallel load, or the budget assertion is moved to a qualification lane with recorded host conditions; a genuine regression past budget still fails.
body: Observed 2026-10-04 on darwin during the issue 395 postmergeproof slice (PR 564) while other packages ran in parallel: internal/liveverify/affected TestIncrementalSelectionMeetsTheLiveBudget failed with p95 173ms against its 100ms budget, then passed when rerun alone. Suspected load-sensitivity of a wall-clock budget assertion, not a confirmed product regression. Expected: the test either measures under a controlled load or reports a budget miss as a retained measurement rather than failing the package under shared-host load.
title: tests: TestIncrementalSelectionMeetsTheLiveBudget p95 exceeds 100ms under parallel load (suspected flake)
